crossRefs.note: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
“After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you…
David and all the house of Israel played before Yahweh with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps…
But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, Yahweh’s hand came on him.
God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and…
Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom…
and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for…
four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down…
Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
translations.bsb: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translations.kjv: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
translations.asv: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
